System Details

Basic information about your Sky Hub.

  • Manufacturer - The maker of your Sky Hub.
  • Model - The model number.
  • Firmware Version - This is the current software your Sky Hub is using.

Modem

The current Modem status and settings are shown in this section.

Broadband Port

These are the current DSL settings. We have configured these settings by default for you.

  • MAC Address - The physical address of the Sky Hub, as seen from the Internet.
  • IPv4 Address - The current Internet IP Address in IPv4 address space. If assigned dynamically, and no Internet connection exists, this will be blank (or 0.0.0.0).
  • Network Type - This indicates the connection type (e.g. PPPoE, IPoE) used on the DSL port.
  • IPv4 Subnet Mask - The subnet mask associated with the Internet IPv4 Address.
  • Gateway IPv4 Address - The Gateway associated with the Internet IPv4 Address.
  • IPv4 Domain Name Server - This displays the Address of the current DNS in IPv4 address space.
  • Gateway IPv6 Address - The Gateway associated with the Internet IPv6 Address.
  • IPv6 Domain Name Server - This displays the address of the current DNS in IPv6 address space. This may be empty if the addresses can be resolved using IPv4 DNS server itself.
  • IPv6 Global Address - The current globally routable Internet IP Address in IPv6 address space. If no Internet connection exists, this will be blank.
  • IPv6 Link Local Address - The IPv6 Private Address assigned for the router in the WAN link. It is unique only on that link and is globally non-routable.
  • IPv6 Delegated Prefix - The IPv6 Prefix obtained from the ISP router that can be assigned by the CPE to the devices connecting to it on the LAN and requesting an IPv6 Address.

WAN Port

The current WAN status and Port details are shown in this section.

  • WAN Port Status - The current state of the WAN connection.
  • Port Detail - The Ethernet port number used for the WAN connection.

LAN Port

These are the current settings, as set in the LAN IP Setup page.

  • MAC Address - The physical address of the Sky Hub, as seen from the local LAN.
  • IPv4 Address - The LAN IP Address of the Sky Hub in IPv4 address space.
  • DHCPv4 - This indicates if the Sky Hub is acting as a DHCP Server for devices on your LAN in IPv4 address space.
  • IPv4 Subnet Mask - The Subnet Mask associated with the LAN IPv4 address.
  • IPv6 ULA - The IPv6 Address to be used by the router in the private (LAN) network. It is globally non-routable.
  • IPv6 Global Address - The current globally routable Internet IP Address in IPv6 address space. If no Internet connection exists, this will be blank.
  • IPv6 Link Local Address - The IPv6 Private Address assigned for the router in the LAN link. It is unique only on that link and is globally non-routable.
  • DHCPv6 - This indicates if the Sky Hub is acting as a DHCP Server for devices on your LAN in IPv6 address space.

WiFi Port

These are the current settings as set in the WiFi Settings page.

  • Name (SSID) - The SSID of your Sky Hub.
  • Region - This should be set to Europe.
  • Current Channel - The current channel(s) in use by your Sky Hub.
  • WiFi AP - This indicates if the Access Point feature of your Sky Hub is enabled or not. If not enabled, the WiFi LED on the front panel of your Sky Hub will be off.
  • Broadcast Name - This indicates if your Sky Hub is broadcasting its SSID.

Attached Devices

This page shows the device name for each device attached to your Sky Hub.

Voice

  • Voice Status

    Disconnected - The Voice function is not currently connected and you will not be able to make or receive calls.

    Connected - The Voice function is connected and you will be able to make and receive calls using the phone plugged into your Sky Hub.

    Connecting - Trying to establish the Voice connection, you will not be able to make or receive calls until the status changes to Connected.

  • Phone Number - Customers assigned phone number.
